strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. Akito's Aestivalis or Daitarn 3 lost
It seems we were jumped from Earth to a lunar city...
but with my unit back, I can't ignore a city of arms factories!
You invaders! I won't let you build any more devilish weapons!
Let's go, Mazin!
That's...! The robot that came here with me...!
At this rate, the city is in danger. Launch the Elshank...
We can't, it's still moored in the dock... We can't launch right away!
Damn! Joe and the others are on Earth... Guess it's up to Daitarn!?
Looks that way...
Londo Bell should be here soon. I'll try to buy time until then.
Please, Banjo... Ah, what's that!?
Hm? ...I see... Looks like you've sorted yourself out, Tenkawa.
Hahaha! You evil Earthlings...
Can't put up a fight? Did the sight of our heroic forms terrify you!?
What...!?
Okay, with this lunar frame, I can operate solo...
Same type as at Kawasaki...? I won't let you do as you please!
Only one machine... Seems some Earthlings have a little backbone...
But evil can only perish!
Whoa there! That's far enough!
What!? Y-you!? ...Curses, this time we settle it!
Oh, we agree. That's my plan too. For the world and its people!
Hm! Ngh!?
Daitarn 3, smasher of evil ambitions!
If you don't fear the brilliance of the sun... come and get me!
He's frozen...!?
Hm!? ...N-no! I got caught up admiring it...
What right do evil invaders have to say that! Feel the power of Mazin!
Tenkawa... you're all right, aren't you?
Yes, Banjo.
I'll fight... to protect the place where I belong!
With this many enemies, don't push it. Hold out until Londo Bell arrives!
Roger!
Now that the Jin series is complete and manned jumps are possible...
we of the Jovian Alliance have no equal!
(I see. They may be called the Jovian Lizards, but... they seem to be
as intelligent as Earthlings or more... No, as human, maybe...?)
Dammit! Daitarn's reliable and all, but with only two of us...
Fighting while protecting a city is tough, even for me.
That's unusual, Banjo, to hear you sound unsure.
Hang in there, Big Bro Banjo! We're coming to help!
That's the Ra Cailum!
Well, well, a lively cavalry has arrived.
Princess, it's Captain Bright and the others.
Ah, they made it in time...
The enemy's deployed. All hands, launch as soon as you're ready!
Support Banjo and the others! Hurry!
Yeah, yeah.
We just stopped the colony, and now we're up against Jupiter's mecha.
Jeez, they're working us way too hard.
Don't complain, Koji. At this rate, the people of Von Braun are in danger.
Hmph, if you want to complain, tell the enemy.
Right, this time the safety of Von Braun's citizens is at stake.
Nina... please be safe...
Hm!? New enemies? One evil hand after another...
but the goddess of victory always smiles on the warriors of justice!
A phase-transition engine ship! Perfect, you legion of evil...
come at me all at once!
We've arrived at Von Braun City.
Confirming Londo Bell is engaged with the Jovian Lizards.
That Aestivalis... Akito!? Is that you, Akito!?
Yurika...? Is that you, Yurika!? You're here already?
Yup, it's for Akito! I came as fast as I could!
This time, Earth's defense line didn't get in our way...
Still... the bridge feels rather lonely.
And things are rather restless aboard the ship...
Seems they're chasing the Jovian Lizard pilot around.
Aestivalis team, launch and back up Akito and Londo Bell, pleeease!
You got it! Hang on, Tenkawa!
It's been a while since we saw the Londo Bell folks.
Yeah! Heh heh heh... Super robots with a different flavor
from the Gandor team's are waiting for us!
Don't get so excited to help that you stall out... Heh... heh heh heh...
Looks like the battle's started...
If we're going to move, now's the time...
Honestly, I feel like we're doing something pretty dangerous.
Especially now that the Jovian Lizards'... er, Jovians' secret is out.
Don't act so smug. That report came from Garrison!
And if all you'll do is complain, you don't have to come along, Reika!
P-please stop. Don't fight over me...
Oh, don't you like being surrounded by beautiful women?
Wh-what, I... um... It's Haruka that I...
My, my, for a man from Jupiter, you're quite the charmer.
Ah, there you are! Why aren't you all on the bridge!?
Hurry... Huh, that guy!? Get away from him!
Wh-what do we do!?
At a time like this... right, Minato?
? What, what?
Right, Reika. ...Shiratori, over there!
Eh? A lady holding my hand... Whoa!
We're getting out of here!
Yes, get away from him, quick... Huh? Why... are you going with him?
Huh? Huh? What just happened?
The Jovian Lizard robot we recovered has launched.
Oh, really. Hmm, so it moves even without a pilot... wait,
Whaaat!? Who's piloting it!?
Yurika, this is bad!
The pilot of the captured mecha took Megumi, Minato,
and Banjo's two assistants hostage...!
What!? Megumi, Minato...!
What...!? ...But... that's odd. Banjo Haran's assistants...
The other one aside, Sanjo was a top International Police agent...
Could they be up to something...
Anyway, contact Londo Bell too!
Aestivalis team, rescuing the abductees is your top priority!
Oh, Shiratori! You escaped the den of evil. I believed in you...!
Well, I did escape, but... mmph.
What's wrong? Is someone else in there?
I guess five people in a one-seater machine... was a bit much...?
Just a bit...
Way too much! Hey, Beauty! Your chest is in the way!
Can't be helped! It's cramped... Ah! Shiratori, don't touch me there!
N-no, this is an accident! I'd never intend such a thing...
(...What's going on in there?)
Genichiro! These people may be from Earth,
but they've agreed to help us.
...I-I see, but... they're all women?
I-I have no impure intentions...!
Ah, at a time like this...
S-s-sorry, Minato... Anyway, I'll lend a hand too, Genichiro!
Whaaat, we're going into battle like this?
I-I don't really get it... but you've brought allies, then.
Very well, second wave! Sortie and cover Shiratori!
What!? There are hostages inside that machine?
The Nadesico's crew... and Banjo's assistants.
I see. Quite a cunning ploy...!
Megumi and Minato!? Dammit! Those dirty rats!
Good grief... Anyway, all we can do is stop that thing.
Huh? Banjo, you're pretty calm.
Aren't you worried about your assistants?
Well, I trust them...
And they should be prepared for the worst.
(He's so easygoing... but he's pretty hard-boiled, huh...)
I won't let the worst happen to Megumi and the others!
We'll all save them together!
Yeah! Pulling a dirty trick like that! ...I'll make 'em regret it!
Enemy reinforcements are here, but... we have to save the hostages!
Phew. If you want to look cool, I'd rethink that villain's exit line.
(But... they don't seem to be beyond reason, these Jovian Lizards...
No, the Jovian Alliance forces. I hope we can find some kind of opening...)
Wait!!
Listen to us!
Megumi, Minato...!? Ngh...! That's dirty, you people from Jupiter!
Huh!?
(People... from Jupiter...?)
Hmm...
(As I thought...)
No, Akito, stop attacking!
For this man's honor, let me say it: we are not hostages.
We were all deceived! These people are...
...I heard it here... They're human, right? Exiled from the Earth Sphere...
Whaaat!? Hey, Tenkawa! Is that true?
Whoa, whoa, isn't that totally different from what we were told?
Could it be... information control!?
Hmph... The brass's favorite trick, information control...
I see... So you were told too...
Step aside, please. We only want the phase-transition engine ship.
Shut up! I'll protect the Nadesico!
No, dragging an old war along...!
You don't get it!! This is "our" war now!
We're on a battleship! Fighting the enemy!
You can't just call it some old war when it suits you!
Get out of that thing!
("Our war," hm... Mankind's foolishness...
brings misfortune regardless of era, or of soldier or civilian.
Does he sense that by instinct...? Is this... youth...?)
Captain Bright!?
...Our goal hasn't changed. Silence that machine and rescue them!
Captain Misumaru, any objections?
Y-yes... th-that's right. Rescue Megumi and Minato!
It stopped? No, not yet! This is for the people of Mars...!
Stop! Akito, please stop!
Wait!! The Tetsujin can no longer fight.
I'll let the four of them off! So face me one-on-one!
Stop it! Please stoooop! Why do you need to do this!
Akito!
It's to protect Earth!
Are people who protect Earth, who fight, so much better!?
This is wrong...! This isn't like you at all, Akito!
...That stings...
You don't have to fight a war!
We could just stay home together watching Gekiganger...!
Megumi...
That's more like you...! More like you...
That's who you are, Akito...
...Yeah. Maybe that is more like me... But that's not who I wanted to be.
Tenkawa...
I thought... instead of being a grown-up who watches Gekiganger,
I could become Gekiganger...
...That's not it, Tenkawa. Our fight... isn't like that.
Battles don't let you pick and choose.
...They're never as cool as in some cartoon.
Right... I guess that's right... Hey, you, from Jupiter. Go...
Thank you... Won't you tell me your name? I'm...
I don't want to kill someone whose name I know.
I see. ...Everyone, please get out... Farewell...
Enemy Gekigan type confirmed withdrawing by Boson Jump.
Ngh!!
Genichiro! Are you all right!?
Looks like this fight's decided.
Curses, next time we meet, I'll beat you for sure!
Sure, I'll be waiting. ...If you dare challenge this sun again...!
Always acting so cool! Remember this!
Looks like that's done. ...But still...
Yeah, it leaves a bad taste...
Akito! I'm so glad you're safe... Nergal took back your firing, too!
Yurika... yeah, so it seems... I heard about that over here...
Otherwise he couldn't fly an Aestivalis without permission.
But... the Jovian Lizards were human...
Yeah... We can't fight them with the same feelings as before...
(Well, it wasn't something we could hide forever.)
So the Jovian Lizards are really human... Did you know, Cap'n Bright?
No... But even if I'd been told, I'd have been sworn to silence.
...The brass kept it hidden... In other words, it's top secret.
The military sure doesn't give you much freedom.
Anyway, we've all regrouped.
Why don't we all gather and meet face to face?
That's right... Oh!
As of today, the mobile battleship Nadesico has joined Londo Bell.
Nice to be working with you!
We're counting on you. ...But...
Yes, I'm worried about the Nadesico crew's morale...
I don't mind a scandalous story, but... this one's different.
